meta.name: give-me-tips
meta.description: Explains any senpi tip in depth, including Tip: lines in the TUI. Use when the user asks about a tip, what a tipped feature does, or which tips they can see.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把界面上看不懂的功能提示讲清楚
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果软件界面里冒出提示,你想弄清它到底在说什么。
copy.tagline_en: Explain any in-app feature tip so you know what it does
copy.fit_line_en: For you if a tip pops up in the interface and you want to know what it means.

howto.what: 当你说起某条 senpi 提示(含 TUI 里的 Tip: 行)时,它先跑 senpi --list-tips 并读取你本机 settings.json,弄清哪些提示你能看到,再读源码核实机制,用你提问的语言给出带具体文件路径的深入解释。
howto.when: 当你问某条提示是什么意思、某个被提示的功能如何工作,或你自己能看到哪些提示时触发。

say.text: 刚才那条 Tip: 是什么意思?
say.note: 它会查实时提示列表并读源码来解释这条提示。

say.text: 我这边实际能看到哪些提示?
Fable 5 拒绝后的那个提示是怎么工作的?
say.note: 它会讲从拒绝检测到 architect 回退的整条流程。

howto.what_en: Explains any senpi tip, including TUI `Tip:` lines, in the language you asked in. It runs `senpi --list-tips` and reads your settings.json to see which tips you can see, then checks the source and cites file paths.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask about a tip, what a tipped feature does, or which tips you can see.

say_en.note: It looks up the live tip list and explains the tip from source.

say_en.text: Which tips can I actually see?
say_en.note: It reads your settings.json and says which tips you can encounter.

say_en.text: How does the tip after a Fable 5 refusal work?
say_en.note: It walks through refusal detection and the architect fallback.
